newsitem.title: LATVIA: BUDGET GROWTH SEEN IN 1998 WITHOUT TAX HIKES.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET GROWTH SEEN IN 1998 WITHOUT TAX HIKES.

text.p: Latvia's Finance Minister Roberts Ziles sees 1998 state budget revenue growth without tax hikes, due to the improving economic situation and state revenue service performance, the daily Dienas bizness said on Thursday.
"The revenue side is planned to grow by 67.8 million lats to 611 million lats which is fairly good," Zile was quoted as saying by the paper.
The growth will also be generated by adding special budgets, including the privatisation fund, into the state budget, Zile told the paper.

The amount of company income tax to be collected in 1998 is planned to decrease compared to 1997 as holding companies have the right to transfer some expenditure items from the daughter to mother company, Zile said.

No income tax rises are planned for 1998 and the ministry hopes that parliament will pass a joint income tax law this year merging the existing company and individual income taxes, Zile was quoted as saying.
